'''''Aechmea racinae''''', or '''Christmas jewels''', is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[genus]] ''[[Aechmea]]'', of the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Bromeliaceae]]. This species is [[Endemism|endemic]] to the State of [[Espírito Santo]] in eastern [[Brazil]].<ref name=m>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=218207 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Martinelli |first1=Gustavo |last2=Vieira |first2=Cláudia Magalhães |last3=Gonzalez |first3=Marcos |last4=Leitman |first4=Paula |last5=Piratininga |first5=Andréa |last6=Costa |first6=Andrea Ferreira da |last7=Forzza |first7=Rafaela Campostrini |title=Bromeliaceae da Mata Atlântica Brasileira: lista de espécies, distribuição e conservação |journal=Rodriguésia |date=January 2008 |volume=59 |issue=1 |pages=209–258 |jstor=23499386 |doi=10.1590/2175-7860200859114 |trans-title=Bromeliaceae of the brazilian Atlantic Forest: checklist, distribution and conservation |language=pt-BR|doi-access=free }}</ref> ''A. racinae'' grows best in partial sun and does not tolerate freezing temperatures.<ref name=":0" />

''Aechmea racinae'' is an [[epiphytic]] [[evergreen]] [[perennial plant|perennial]], forming basal rosettes of strap-shaped leaves, with arching [[racemes]] of tubular red and yellow [[flower]]s that give way to [[Berry|berries]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Hortipedia - Aechmea racinae|url=https://en.hortipedia.com/Aechmea_racinae|access-date=2021-04-06|website=en.hortipedia.com}}</ref> In [[temperateness|temperate]] regions it is often grown as a [[houseplant]]. It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://apps.rhs.org.uk/plantselector/plant?plantid=5111 |title=RHS Plant Selector Aechmea racinae AGM / RHS Gardening |publisher=Apps.rhs.org.uk |date= |accessdate=2012-08-21}}</ref>
